lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into a semi-regular grid consisting of approximately 8-10 visible vertical columns and multiple horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by sharp vertical gradients with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal aspect and deep shadows on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: The rostrum area anterior to the gills exhibits a localized transition to a high-density distribution of smaller, non-uniformly arranged high-luminance spots.
